scope: Construction of one explicitly selected 180 m potable-water production borehole BH-PW-180-DN250 with a 311 mm final bore, 180 m DN250 casing, 36 m stainless V-wire screen, one 45 m3/h submersible pump, 160 m DN80 rising main and one sanitary wellhead. Geological logging, gravel pack, annular grouting, sanitary seal, headworks, electrical-controls, development, testing, labor, mechanisms and logistics are project-owned.
sourceAuthority: Approved hydrogeological design, borehole log, drilling program, casing-screen schedule, gravel and grout specification, pump duty calculation, headworks and electrical-control drawings, pumping-test program, water laboratory, suppliers and approving project engineer
forbiddenClaims: hard-coded 80 m drilling depth or casing schedule
casing, screen, gravel, grout, labor, mechanism or logistics quantities derived from a generic length coefficient
automatic temporary access, drilling-fluid disposal or standby power
universal retained spare or supplier-joint length
distribution network, reservoir, treatment plant, sewerage or invented price
